Name: Undersea Decorations
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
mainly made for myself since my farms are always sea themed and i could always use more sea-type decorations :)

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. download and install alternative textures
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ [b]how to use:[/b] purchase the paint bucket from robin and use it on the following furniture items to change to their corresponding undersea versions:
[b]Bear Statue[/b] - all mermaids, clam shell
[b]House Plant[/b] - bubbles, fish
[b]Long Cactus[/b] - all jellyfish, octopus
♡ sprites made by me with exception of some that come from stardew itself (mermaid, moonlight jellies)
